items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: Just him and a fellow, a Italian fellow, he called Joe Bolina.

ctx.x: I said, Joey, sure? Yeah, sure.

So, well, what we did, we started playing for him. Well, we played all during the time of the war for him. See? And we, of course, in fact, we was the first ones starting out in dances. You see, he was a man who had a restaurant. He was in a restaurant up there by the Seller's Tax. You see, all up there didn't have nothing up at the Seller's Tax. No building at all around there. Nothing but used to raise garden and different things, you know. Just him and a fellow, a Italian fellow, he called Joe Bolina. You see,…
